summary: Enova International filed an Item 8.01 8-K announcing pricing of a private Rule 144A/Reg S offering of $600 million senior unsecured notes due 2031 at 100.000% of par with an 8.750% coupon, guaranteed by existing and future domestic subsidiaries (securitization subsidiaries excluded). Expected closing is November 20, 2026. Net proceeds will redeem all outstanding 11.25% 2028 notes on December 15, 2026, pay fees and expenses, and repay revolver borrowings; the redemption is conditioned on the offering. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation; watch for market reception of the upsize and any rating actions.
